label: Actual root existence over whole-roster nontrapping: certified difference
note: Difference of root existence and whole-roster nontrapping on the same profile, selected relation and world: the strong version adds exactly that the actual roster is inhabited and that root existence is stable (not-not root existence gives root existence). Stability is the constructive price of the double negation in nontrapping; it follows from excluded middle for this one proposition, so under excluded middle the difference is population alone, as the existing exact-strength comparison WholeRosterRootEquivalenceAt states. Given population, the stability conjunct is constructively equivalent to 'nontrapping implies root existence' (stabilityIsRootImplicationGivenPopulation), so the substantive difference is population; stability is the logical price of the double negation.
